question: Which of the following authors has written the great English novel ‘Moby-Dick’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Herman Melville**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Herman Melville:**

 
 
• Herman Melville (1819-1891) was an American novelist, short story writer, and poet of the American Renaissance period.
